mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, description, sort_order AS "sortOrder", status FROM category ORDER BY sort_order, id
INSERT INTO category (code, name, description, sort_order, status) VALUES (#{entity.code}, #{entity.name}, #{entity.description}, #{entity.sortOrder}, #{entity.status}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE category SET code = #{entity.code}, name = #{entity.name}, description = #{entity.description}, sort_order = #{entity.sortOrder}, status = #{entity.status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{entity.id}
